audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Illaoi six of seven stages while its own whys read 'a clean even farm window' at 1, 'still even' at 2, 'it lands neutral' at 6 and 'mine for good' at two items. The full layer also carried diff HARD against a 6/10 rating, a 54.23% Cho'Gath win rate and its own 'Even matchup' final line.
audit.why: Levels 1-2 are even because Test of Spirit is not up and she has no tentacle field. 3 through 5 are hers. 6 is neutral once Feast exists. First item is hers on lifesteal. Two items is Cho'Gath's outright — off her field she is immobile and Feast is true damage.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill / Illaoi / Cho'Gath; diff set to EVEN to match the 6/10 rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phase whys were generic template text with no cooldowns; the level-6 line said only 'Illaoi's ultimate changes the math too'.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s at 900 range, Harsh Lesson only 4s, Leap of Faith 120/95/70s and Feast 80/70/60s. The page told the reader to 'engage on Test of Spirit's cooldown' without ever saying how long that is, and it never mentioned that Rupture's 950 range beats her E's 900.
audit.corrected: Test of Spirit 16s, Harsh Lesson 4s, Leap of Faith 120s and Feast 80s now appear in the phase and cooldown fields, along with the 950-versus-900 range edge.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every interaction field said only 'Her vessel pull. Sidestep it.' It never stated what the spirit actually does, and it implied Harsh Lesson was a cooldown worth baiting.
audit.why: Riot's text: the spirit echoes a percentage of the damage it takes back to you, and if it dies — or if you get too far from it — you become a Vessel and start spawning her tentacles yourself. That is the mechanic, not a 'pull'. Feral Scream (11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) is the answer because a silenced Illaoi cannot cast Test of Spirit or Leap of Faith. Harsh Lesson is a 4-second dash, so it is not a cooldown you can wait out; her tentacles spawn on impassable terrain, so the positional rule is to fight away from walls.
audit.corrected: The spirit echoes damage back to you — kill it or stay close, or you become a Vessel.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer's early, mid, late and all seven whys are first person ('both of us are soft', 'I farm off Carnivore', 'Mine for good'), and Illaoi is called 'he'/'his' in tradeGood, dosFull[1].d, breakdown.trading, breakdown.mid, breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late, dontsFull[0].d and report[3]/report[4]/report[12].
audit.why: Both defects are voice errors a reader trips over immediately, and the misgendering runs through the trading advice.
audit.corrected: Content prose converted to second person; pronouns fixed in every full-layer field edited here.

notes: Illaoi's kit file tags Leap of Faith (R) with 'grounding' and 'untargetable'; Riot's own description mentions neither, only damage and a tentacle per champion hit. I did not assert either. Unverified and left alone: whether the spirit's health scales with Cho'Gath's stacked max HP (widely believed, but not stated in Riot's text) — if true it is a significant point in Cho'Gath's favour and worth a targeted check. Cho'Gath's kit flags Rupture as 'grounding'; Riot's text says it pops enemies into the air, so I wrote knockup.
